獅子吼"From today’s work, you could manage a lordship well enough. Kill Chachamaru and take her seat; no particular difficulty."
獅子吼"I have done something similar. Chachamaru herself killed her parent and took the position. Who is going to begin objecting now merely because you do the same?"
Kageaki"...Sir. The jest has become a little excessive."
獅子吼"Hmph... Has it? Very well."
獅子吼"Then let us change the meaning. By cut her off, I mean give her up."
Kageaki"Give her up?"
獅子吼"Leave Chachamaru and serve me. I promise good treatment."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"A regiment. With promotion to colonel, naturally."
獅子吼"Well? Having been born a man, what greater satisfaction than leading a regiment over the battlefield?"
Kageaki"That... I cannot deny, sir."

en.html:
獅子吼"Do you prefer Chachamaru so greatly?"
Kageaki"I am grateful for her raising me from civilian obscurity."
獅子吼"Do not speak what you do not mean. The false note is quite audible."
Kageaki"An unfortunate lapse..."
獅子吼"Every answer takes a bite out of its listener. Hmph. Infuriating."
獅子吼"I do not consider myself inferior to that little asura of a girl. Do you see such a difference?"
Kageaki"Certainly not, sir."
獅子吼"Then why? Why insist upon Chachamaru?"
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"Ah. You mentioned it... common interests, something of that sort."
獅子吼"Circumstances prevent you from leaving her?"
Kageaki"...Your interpretation is your own, sir."
獅子吼"And if I offered to take charge of those circumstances?"
Kageaki"Your Excellency... what puzzles me is a man of your standing persisting so greatly over one insignificant officer."
Kageaki"May I ask your true reason?"
獅子吼"Changing the subject? Hmph... Today I shall permit it."
獅子吼"Over-pursuit is forbidden in warfare, after all."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"I seek you because I value your ability. But... that is not the only reason."
Kageaki"What other reason, sir?"
獅子吼"..."
Kageaki"...?"
獅子吼"Your face somehow reminds me of my younger brother. Peculiar. I no longer remember his face."
Kageaki"You had a younger brother, sir?"

獅子吼"We separated as children. Where he is, what he does... whether he lives, I do not know. If alive, he should be about your age."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"That is all. Hmph. A foolish fancy. Men of your age are plentiful enough."
獅子吼"Yet only you... seem strangely familiar."
Kageaki"Sir..."
獅子吼"Hmph. Nonsense. Ridiculous. Delusion, this is. Nonsense. Hmph... Not much future for me either, apparently. Fool."
獅子吼"Keeping you near, I apparently wish to feel that I live and fight beside a brother of my own blood. Nonsense... utter nonsense!"
獅子吼"Me, of all people!"
Kageaki"..."

For a while I had no words for the lieutenant general mocking himself as he looked at the ceiling. The wall clock ticked into the emptiness.

Somehow the dining hall had emptied. The air felt a little cold.

en.html:
Kageaki"...Whatever army we serve, it is the same Rokuhara. Your Excellency and I shall still fight shoulder to shoulder."
Kageaki"If I may be permitted to put it so."
獅子吼"Hmph. Words..."
獅子吼"Loyalty to Rokuhara is not why you fight."
Kageaki"...If Your Excellency is our model of loyalty, then indeed I have no answer."
Kageaki"You embody Rokuhara’s justice itself."
獅子吼"Oh? Is that how I appear?"
Kageaki"Could it be otherwise?"
獅子吼"Not otherwise. No."
Kageaki"...?"
獅子吼"Justice. Loyalty."
獅子吼"But in the end, private desire. I do it because I wish to do it."
獅子吼"Considered that way... we are the same. Whatever you are plotting, I have no standing to reproach you."
獅子吼"The same private motive. The same self-interest."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"Everyone may have one value he believes in without condition. Several would make him either a fool or a saint."
獅子吼"Family, a close friend. I have neither now... but I have my country."
獅子吼"This country, Yamato, I can believe in. To protect it, I can throw away my life."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"You have something also, do you not?"
Kageaki"...Yes, sir."
Kageaki"I do."
獅子吼"Then we are of the same kind. Even if not comrades..."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"...Hmph. Nonsense. I have been speaking most uncharacteristically."
獅子吼"Nonsense. Foolishness, on my part."
Kageaki"Sir..."
獅子吼"I have taken your time. I shall go."

ja.html:
景明 「……どの軍にいようと、同じ六波羅。 　閣下と自分とが肩を並べて戦うことに違い はないかと」
景明 「このような言い様が許されるのであれば、 ですが」
獅子吼 「ふん。 　口先だな……」
獅子吼 「貴様が戦う理由は、六波羅への忠義などで はなかろう」
景明 「…………。 　大鳥閣下を以て忠臣の鑑とするのであれば、 成程、返す言葉もございません」
景明 「閣下はまさに、六波羅の正義を体現される 御方ゆえ」
獅子吼 「ほう。 　そう見えるか？」
景明 「違いましょうや」
獅子吼 「違いはせんな。 　違いはせんが」
景明 「……？」
獅子吼 「正義。 　忠義」
獅子吼 「しかし、所詮は私心だ。 　俺がやりたくてやっているに過ぎんからな」
獅子吼 「そう考えれば……ふん、同じか。 　貴様が脳裏で何を企もうと、詰れた筋合い ではないわ」
獅子吼 「同じ私心。 　同じ私利私欲よ」
景明 「……」
獅子吼 「誰にもひとつくらいは無条件で信じられる 価値があっていい。 　いくつもあったら単なる馬鹿か聖人だがな」
獅子吼 「家族だの、親友だの。 　今の俺にはどちらも無いが……国家がある」
獅子吼 「この大和という国だけは信じられる。 　守り通すため、身命を擲てる」
景明 「…………」
獅子吼 「貴様にも何か、あるのだろう？」
景明 「……はい。閣下」
景明 「あります」
獅子吼 「ならば俺達は同類だ。 　同胞ではないのだとしてもな……」
景明 「…………」
獅子吼 「……ふん。下らん。 　俺は随分と、らしくないことを話していた ようだ」
獅子吼 「下らん。愚かしいな。我ながら」
景明 「閣下……」
獅子吼 「時間を取らせたな。 　俺はもう行く」

en.html:
Before I could rise and salute, the lieutenant general of the Dragon Corps had vanished from view and left the dining hall.

Left behind, I stared for a while at the empty seat.

...Private desire.

A value believed in without condition.
